entries.statement: At least one evaluated quantum computing approach can achieve utility-scale operation — computational value exceeding cost — by 2033.
entries.resolution_criteria: A QBI Stage C verification-and-validation determination that a utility-scale system was constructed as designed and operated as intended; program is explicit that multiple, one, or zero participants may succeed.
entries.note: Program goal recorded as a testable institutional forecast — the observatory will score whether government technical selection was predictive.

entries.statement: PsiQuantum will operate a utility-scale, fault-tolerant photonic quantum computer at a Quantum Compute Center before 2030.
entries.resolution_criteria: A utility-scale system operational and demonstrably running workloads at a QCC (Brisbane or Chicago), confirmed by sources outside PsiQuantum.
entries.note: Company roadmap ambition translated into a resolvable forecast; company phrasing varies ('end of decade'), so the resolving date is set conservatively.

entries.statement: By end of 2026, NQCC publishes an evaluation of the installed Quantum Motion testbed containing at least one independently measured qubit performance figure (fidelity, coherence, or readout).
entries.resolution_criteria: An NQCC-authored publication or report with measured figures for the Quantum Motion system; a marketing update or non-technical blog post does not resolve it.
entries.note: The observatory's own first logged forecast — the system's calibration record starts with a prediction it can lose.
